issue.title: CodeMind proposes a fix for promotion with no regression test, so 'tests pass' proved nothing
issue.symptom: 24bs trial (2026-11-25, her issue gi-2fbe7e, cycle cm-20261125-201247, /shared/codemind/attempts/cm-20261125-201247): her regression test was discarded (a markdown fence, see the next bead), the replay check had no playbook to run, and her patch — stripping '____' from the reply, unrelated to the bug — passed the module's 85 tests because it changes nothing they check. CodeMind marked the issue 'proposed' and wrote an architect-queue manifest (rejected by hand, file restored). For an issue-sourced fix, keeping it should need proof the bug is gone: a regression test that failed before and passes after, or a replay; without either, record the attempt but don't propose it.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-common/tests/test_regression_fence_bqzt.py
"""bqzt: a regression test wrapped in a markdown fence, or talked around, is
taken out of it instead of discarded as a syntax error."""
from gaia_common.utils.codemind_regression import extract_test_code, validate_test_code

CODE = "from gaia_core.cognition import second_mind as sm\n\n\ndef test_x():\n    assert sm\n"


def test_fenced_and_talked_around():
    for reply in (f"```python\n{CODE}```", f"Here is the test:\n\n```python\n{CODE}```\n\nIt fails before the fix.",
                  f"{CODE}```", f"```\n{CODE}"):
        out = extract_test_code(reply)
        assert out == CODE.strip(), reply
        assert validate_test_code(out, "gaia_core.cognition.second_mind")[0]


def test_the_block_with_the_test_is_chosen():
    reply = f"```bash\npytest tests/x.py\n```\n\n```python\n{CODE}```"
    assert extract_test_code(reply) == CODE.strip()


def test_plain_text_unchanged():
    assert extract_test_code(CODE) == CODE.strip()

def test_no_proof_the_bug_is_gone_nothing_kept(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """n0by: tests that pass only say nothing broke."""
    s, target, iid, shared, prompts = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch, "agent_core.py")
    before = target.read_text()
    s._codemind_write_regression_test = MagicMock(return_value=None)   # declined / discarded
    s._run_codemind_cycle()
    assert target.read_text() == before                                # restored
    assert s._codemind_write_regression_test.call_count == 2           # asked again on the retry
    issue = L.get_issue(iid)["issue"]
    assert issue["status"] != "proposed"
    assert "nothing showed the bug is gone" in issue["notes"][-1]["text"]
    assert not list((shared / "doctor" / "architect_queue").glob("*.json"))
    assert not list((shared / "doctor" / "restart_requests").glob("*.json"))
    assert "nothing showed the bug is gone" in prompts[-1]             # told why on the retry

@@ -26,6 +26,29 @@ from gaia_common.utils.skill_creator import slugify_pattern
 _TEST_DEF = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:async\s+)?def\s+test_\w+", re.M)
 
 
+_FENCED = re.compile(r"```[\w+-]*[ \t]*\n(.*?)\n[ \t]*```", re.S)   # paired left to right
+_OPEN_FENCE = re.compile(r"```[\w+-]*[ \t]*\n(.*)\Z", re.S)
+
+
+def extract_test_code(text: str) -> str:
+    """The test module out of a reply that wraps it in a markdown fence or
+    talks around it (bqzt: Prime added a fence though asked not to, and the
+    whole test was discarded as a syntax error at the ``` line). The fenced
+    block holding a `def test_` (the longest, if several); an unclosed fence
+    runs to the end; with no fence, the text itself."""
+    text = text or ""
+    if "```" not in text:
+        return text.strip()
+    blocks = [b.strip() for b in _FENCED.findall(text) if b.strip()]
+    if not blocks:
+        tail = _OPEN_FENCE.search(text)   # an opening fence never closed
+        blocks = [tail.group(1).strip()] if tail and _TEST_DEF.search(tail.group(1)) else []
+    tests = [b for b in blocks if _TEST_DEF.search(b)]
+    if tests:
+        return max(tests, key=len)
+    return "\n".join(ln for ln in text.splitlines() if not ln.strip().startswith("```")).strip()
+
